## Ruled · 2026-11-17T05:07Z

Maintainer (Yibo Wang, seat 3 thread decision card, 2026-11-17T05:07Z) chose 「只放宽多文件附件」 for item 3 (attachments full row):

- PR #34645 lands as is with `Fixes #34607`: attachments stay one cell in this card.
- Follow-up (a new card, for the filer): in the **form** auto-layout, file/image fields with `multiple: true` take a full row, mirroring plugin-detail's existing `MULTI_FILE_FIELD_TYPES` / `isWideDetailField` rule (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/autoLayout.ts:85-115`). Single-file fields stay one cell (the docblock at :80-83 and plugin-detail CHANGELOG keep that on purpose). It applies to the full-page form too, which the maintainer accepted with this choice. Note `WIDE_FIELD_TYPES` is two module-private copies (plugin-form `autoLayout.ts:59`, plugin-detail `autoLayout.ts:53`), not one shared set.

Independent read-only fable review informed the options.
